data.name: Prayer Attack
data.description: As a standard action, you can cause a victim within 30 ft. who can see you to be fascinated (Will save DC%1, +2 if wielding two sawtooth sabres). After 3 rounds of concentrating, you can make a coup de grace attack against your victim.|10+RedMantisLvl+CHA
